name: Standard Chem & Pharm Co. Ltd.
summary: Standard Chem & Pharm Co. Ltd. (SCP) is a Taiwanese enterprise specializing in the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of a broad spectrum of pharmaceutical products, nutritional supplements, and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs). The company's diverse offerings include medications targeting various therapeutic areas, such as the circulatory, digestive, and respiratory systems. Their portfolio also features antihistamines, central nervous system (CNS) agents, metabolism-regulating drugs, anti-microbial treatments, and topical preparations for skin and mucous membrane conditions. Beyond finished drug products, SCP provides APIs for both human and veterinary applications, as well as various pharmaceutical excipients. Founded in 1967, Standard Chem & Pharm Co. Ltd. maintains its corporate headquarters in Tainan City, Taiwan.
